development.data: already-consumed PILOT-012 and PILOT-013 development streams only
development.primary_objective: lower mean real range-coded payload bpb, subject to the hard per-stream actual neural-evaluation budget
tie_break: lower mean actual neural evaluation fraction

feature.definition: number of distinct byte values among the first 32 already-consumed bytes of the current 512-byte block
feature.name: unique_count_32

hypotheses.primary: mean retained cheap-reset to neural-reset gain >= 0.50 and mean PILOT-015 payload bpb below PILOT-014 on the same fresh holdout
hypotheses.secondary: longer cheap-only evidence outweighs delayed neural activation without more selector complexity or neural compute
hypotheses.secondary_stream_wins: PILOT-015 beats PILOT-014 on at least four of six fresh streams

selector.decision: admit iff unique_count_32 <= T and the causal complete-block budget permits
